data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows a segmented progress bar with optional legend, following Primer design.
data.what_it_does: It renders a horizontal bar divided into colored segments based on provided values. A legend below can describe each segment and can be hidden or truncated. The widget is fully customizable via segment definitions and legend style.
use_when: You need a multi‑segment progress visualization matching Primer design
You want an automatic legend that can be limited or hidden
You require simple, declarative configuration without extra code
avoid_when: A single‑value linear progress indicator is sufficient
You need animated or interactive progress bars
You target platforms that require a different design system
strengths: Matches Primer Design System out of the box
Built‑in legend with line‑limit and ellipsis support
Easy to configure with just a list of Segment objects
weaknesses: Limited to static display, no built‑in animations
Only supports the Primer visual style

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides standard Material progress indicators and can be styled to fit custom designs
